description: Open source previs software in the browser: block a scene, pose characters, author camera moves and cuts, then take the same shots to an AI video model.

latest_release.name: CozyClay v3.2.3
latest_release.body:
Install without a terminal on Windows and macOS, a dark Studio with a guided first visit, Auto Pose, camera roll and per-part motion keys, plus cast and stability fixes.

Install

- On Windows the Install dialog leads with one download, `CozyClay-Setup.exe`;
  the Node.js and terminal steps stay one click away. (#1188)
- On macOS the Install dialog leads with one download, `CozyClay.dmg`: a
  signed, notarized app that opens the Studio in its own window, with no
  Terminal. `cozyclay.org/install.sh` stays for a one-line install. (#1190)
- The landing page has one Install action; its dialog asks which computer the
  Studio goes on. Phones are not offered Install. (#1281, #1189)
- An install that starts in the hosted Studio says `--via playground`, and an
  installer start keeps its `installer` label on first launch. (#1183, #1258)

Studio

- The Studio starts in the dark theme. A theme already chosen in Preferences
  is kept. (#1163)
- A first visit to the hosted Studio opens on a ready stage with a character
  on it, then the eight-step camera tutorial in English, 한국어 or 简体中文.
  `npx cozyclay` keeps the project chooser. (#1159, #1161)
- Sample motions in the Motion tab: one click installs a walk or a flip on the
  selected character and plays it, with no agent. (#1156)
- Fix and tell, Annotate, pose keys, lying poses and a more compact shell.
  (#1131)
- The Auto Pose tool. (#1257)
- Import a character file on another rig and play it on its own bones. (#1150)
- A large world scale for full-size exterior scenes. (#1143)
- A smaller gizmo, a repaired Add menu, and a narrow Studio, HUD and install
  commands that stay usable. (#1182, #1264)

Camera

- Roll the shot camera about its lens axis. (#1144)
- Record mouse aim while the rail plays. (#1262)
- Rail readouts stay in sync with the rendered camera. (#1265)

Motion

- Keys are fixed per body part and merge, the Plan card folds, and the beat
  board is gone. (#1219)
- The v4 motion engine, on CozyClay's agent loop and on Claude Code, as
  opt-in Studio Agent models; body motion runs as a motion task designed
  first. (#1134, #1138)
- Rig templates compile specs on non-Mixamo rigs; flight physics with FLOAT,
  DROP and SPIN checks; `fix.self` repairs arms through the body. (#1148,
  #1149, #1154)
- QA measures fingers, palms, knees and torso against the floor and objects,
  and stops at the first take a viewer would accept; trivial spec slips are
  corrected instead of refusing the spec. (#1113, #1114, #1126)

Agent

- A task card names the model it runs on. (#1165)
- A visible thing is built as one detailed sculpt, looked at and copied.
  (#1169)
- On the hosted Studio the Agent panel shows four ready-made requests and an
  Install button instead of a server error. (#1156)
- The generation prompt describes every visible character, keeps the real
  aspect ratio, and no longer invents a location or look. (#1213, #1238)
- Tool descriptions and prompts match the code. (#1228, #1239)

Export

- Choose the video export's pixel size. (#1145)

Cast and shots

- Every cast member keeps a stable identity; shots persist and follow the
  named cast and frame groups. (#1244)
- A character whose model fails to load falls back to the proxy figure, and
  aborted model loads recover. (#1197, #1284)

Fixes

- Opening a project normalizes stored objects instead of throwing; save
  records a written file as saved. (#1196, #1207)
- A task that touched more than 100 objects finishes normally; an edit no
  longer rebuilds every sculpt. (#1167, #1168)
- Fixed a Pin-tool scrub update loop and uncaught pointer and sculpt errors.
  (#1195, #1186)
- The unfinished Workflow entry points are hidden. (#1211)

Site

- The hosted Studio (`cozyclay.org/app/`) records masked PostHog session
  replays: inputs and the agent transcript are masked, the 3D viewport is
  sampled at 2 fps, and no console logs or network contents are kept. The
  landing page and the npm package never record. The privacy page says so.

detail.readme:
English · 한국어 · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português (BR) · Русский

Make the scene first. Then make it a video.
Open source previs in a browser tab: block the set, move the cast, cut the camera, hand the shot to an AI video model.

Try it in the browser · Quick start · Guide for AI agents · Docs · Changelog · Discord

Top: the greybox blocked in CozyClay. Bottom: the AI video made from it. Same idea, a parkour jump: the blocking holds the timing and the camera.
## Why AI video costs money per take, and one miss means paying again. A text prompt cannot hold a whole scene: where everyone stands, how they move, where the camera is, when it cuts. CozyClay lets you make those decisions first, in 3D, where they are cheap to change. Then the video model gets the shot as a first frame, a greybox reference clip and a prompt that describes the real framing. It follows the blocking instead of guessing. ```mermaid flowchart LR S["Stage
set + cast"] --> M["Motion
compiled + QA"] --> C["Camera
shots + cuts"] --> E["Export
frame · clip · prompt"] --> V["AI video model"] ``` ## Quick start ```bash npx cozyclay ``` That is the whole install. You need Node.js 22.19 or newer and a Chromium browser. You do not need a GPU, Python or a model download. The studio opens at `http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/`. **Updating.** - `npx cozyclay` fetches the newest release on every run. - After `npm install -g cozyclay`, the studio shows an **Update** chip in the top bar when a release is out. **Update now** installs it. **Restart now** starts the new version in the same terminal. - On Windows the chip shows the command to copy instead. One-click update stays off there by design. - `cclay update` does the same from the terminal. - Turn the check off for one launch with `--no-update-check` or `COZYCLAY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`. Turn it off for good with `cclay update --off`, and back on with `cclay update --on`. > **Asking an AI agent to set it up?** Give it this repository link. Its instructions are in > [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md). ## What you can do | | | | --- | --- | | **Stage** | Build the set from primitives. Add rigged characters, or capsule stand-ins when nobody needs to move a limb. Fly the view like a 3D editor. | | **Move** | Describe the action. The agent writes a motion spec, and a deterministic compiler in the browser bakes every frame. QA checks collisions, foot slide, reach and hand contact before you see it. | | **Shoot** | Put shots on a timeline, draw dolly rails, look through the lens. Each shot knows the limits of the video model you target. | | **Export** | Keyframe pack (first and last frame, greybox clip, camera, prompt), mp4, depth and normal passes, contact sheet, OTIO cut list. | | **Storyboard** | Prefer stills? A Storyboard project is a row of panels with captions, an animatic and a contact sheet. | | **Undo anything** | Every edit, including each change the agent makes, is one undo step. | ## Direct it with AI The same scene can be driven from three places, live, while you watch the viewport. | Surface | Start | For | | --- | --- | --- | | **Agent panel** | `Cmd/Ctrl+B` in the studio | Chat in the studio. Sign in with ChatGPT or use your own key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, MiniMax, OpenRouter, CLIProxyAPI). | | **MCP server** | `npx -y cozyclay mcp` | Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client. | | **Terminal** | `cclay live status --wait` | Coding agents that drive a running studio, JSON in and out. | ```json { "mcpServers": { "cozyclay": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "cozyclay", "mcp"] } } } ``` ## From source ```bash git clone https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay.git && cd CozyClay npm install npm run dev # http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/ npm test ``` Contribution rules are in [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md). Open pull requests against `main`. ## Docs | Read | For | | --- | --- | | [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md) | Install, run and connect, written for AI agents | | [`docs/motion3-agent-guide.md`](docs/motion3-agent-guide.md) | Motion specs, compile and QA | | [`docs/agent-cli.md`](docs/agent-cli.md) | `cclay live`, model providers, sessions | | [`mcp/README.md`](mcp/README.md) | MCP tools and the live protocol | | [`docs/studio-ui-ia.md`](docs/studio-ui-ia.md) | Every control and where it lives | | [`docs/privacy.md`](docs/privacy.md) | Anonymous telemetry and how to turn it off (`cclay telemetry off`) | | [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) | Contribution rules | ## Guides | Read | For | | --- | --- | | [Greybox to AI video](https://cozyclay.org/greybox-to-video/) | Why a grey blockout is the most reliable input for a video model, and the block-then-generate loop | | [Previs software compared](https://cozyclay.org/previs-software/) | Free, open source and browser-based previs tools side by side | | [Seedance 2.5 camera control](https://cozyclay.org/seedance-camera-control/) | Getting the same camera on every take with a reference clip | | [Camera control for AI video](https://cozyclay.org/ai-camera-control/) | Why camera prompts drift and what the models actually accept | Found a bug or want a feature? [Open an issue](https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay/issues). ## License AGPL-3.0-or-later. See [`LICENSE`](LICENSE), [`LICENSING.md`](LICENSING.md) and [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). English · 한국어 · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português (BR) · Русский

先做场景，再做视频。
浏览器标签页里的开源预演工具:搭场景、调度角色、切镜头,再把镜头交给 AI 视频模型。

在浏览器中试用 · 快速开始 · AI 代理指南 · 更新日志 · Discord

上:在 CozyClay 中搭好的灰盒。下:据此生成的 AI 视频。 同样的思路,一个跑酷跳跃:预演锁定了节奏和镜头。
## 为什么需要它 AI 视频每出一条都要花钱,一次不中就得再付一次。单靠文字提示词,装不下整个场景:每个人站在哪、怎么动、摄影机在哪、何时切镜头。 CozyClay 让你先在 3D 里把这些决定做好,这时修改成本最低。随后视频模型拿到的是首帧、灰盒参考片段,以及描述真实构图的提示词。它会遵循预演,而不是自己猜。 ```mermaid flowchart LR S["Stage
set + cast"] --> M["Motion
compiled + QA"] --> C["Camera
shots + cuts"] --> E["Export
frame · clip · prompt"] --> V["AI video model"] ``` ## 快速开始 ```bash npx cozyclay ``` 安装只需这一步。需要 Node.js 22.19 或更高版本,以及 Chromium 内核浏览器。不需要 GPU、Python,也不用下载模型。工作室会在 `http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/` 打开。 **更新。** - `npx cozyclay` 每次运行都会获取最新版本。 - 用 `npm install -g cozyclay` 安装后,有新版本时工作室顶栏会出现 **Update** 标签。**Update now** 负责安装,**Restart now** 在同一终端启动新版本。 - 在 Windows 上,标签会显示可复制的命令。一键更新在此处被有意关闭。 - 在终端中,`cclay update` 效果相同。 - 单次启动要关闭检查,用 `--no-update-check` 或 `COZYCLAY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`。永久关闭用 `cclay update --off`,重新开启用 `cclay update --on`。 > **让 AI 代理帮你安装?** 把本仓库链接给它即可。说明在 > [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md)。 ## 你能做什么 | | | | --- | --- | | **Stage** | 用基本体搭建场景。添加带骨骼的角色;不需要动四肢时,用胶囊体替身。像 3D 编辑器一样飞行查看。 | | **Move** | 描述动作。代理编写动作规格,浏览器中的确定性编译器烘焙每一帧。碰撞、脚滑、够取距离和手部接触,会在你看到之前由 QA 检查。 | | **Shoot** | 把镜头放到时间线上,画轨道,通过镜头取景。每个镜头都清楚目标视频模型的限制。 | | **Export** | 关键帧包(首帧和末帧、灰盒片段、摄影机、提示词)、mp4、深度和法线通道、联系表、OTIO 剪辑列表。 | | **Storyboard** | 更喜欢静帧?Storyboard 项目由带字幕的一排画板、动态分镜和联系表组成。 | | **Undo anything** | 每一次编辑,包括代理做的每个改动,都是一个撤销步骤。 | ## 用 AI 来导演 同一个场景可以从三处实时驱动,你可以边看视口边操作。 | 方式 | 启动 | 适用 | | --- | --- | --- | | **Agent panel** | `Cmd/Ctrl+B` | 工作室内的聊天。用 ChatGPT 登录,或使用自己的密钥(Anthropic、OpenAI、Gemini、MiniMax、OpenRouter、CLIProxyAPI)。 | | **MCP server** | `npx -y cozyclay mcp` | Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor 或任意 MCP 客户端。 | | **Terminal** | `cclay live status --wait` | 驱动运行中工作室的编码代理,输入输出均为 JSON。 | ```json { "mcpServers": { "cozyclay": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "cozyclay", "mcp"] } } } ``` ## 从源码运行 ```bash git clone https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay.git && cd CozyClay npm install npm run dev # http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/ npm test ``` 贡献规则见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。请向 `main` 提交拉取请求。 ## 文档 | 阅读 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md) | 面向 AI 代理的安装、运行和连接说明 | | [`docs/motion3-agent-guide.md`](docs/motion3-agent-guide.md) | 动作规格、编译与 QA | | [`docs/agent-cli.md`](docs/agent-cli.md) | `cclay live`、模型提供方、会话 | | [`mcp/README.md`](mcp/README.md) | MCP 工具与实时协议 | | [`docs/studio-ui-ia.md`](docs/studio-ui-ia.md) | 每个控件及其位置 | | [`docs/privacy.md`](docs/privacy.md) | 匿名遥测及关闭方法(`cclay telemetry off`) | | [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) | 贡献规则 | ## 指南 | 阅读 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [Greybox to AI video](https://cozyclay.org/greybox-to-video/) | 为什么灰色白模是视频模型最可靠的输入,以及先预演再生成的流程 | | [Previs software compared](https://cozyclay.org/previs-software/) | 免费、开源、基于浏览器的预演工具对比 | | [Seedance 2.5 camera control](https://cozyclay.org/seedance-camera-control/) | 用参考片段让每次生成的镜头保持一致 | | [Camera control for AI video](https://cozyclay.org/ai-camera-control/) | 摄影机提示词为何会漂移,以及模型实际接受什么 | 发现 bug 或想要新功能?[提交 issue](https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay/issues)。 ##
